property_summary: For any caller who has locked a guess for block B, calling settle in the reference always REVERTS if called at block B (i.e. before block.number > B), whereas the mutant allows settling at block B (block.number >= B) so it can succeed or behave differently for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the block-number comparison to allow settling at the same block (use >= instead of >), which can make some calls succeed that previously reverted (or vice versa) depending on guesses[msg.sender].block.
